steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Addiction is a chronic disorder characterised by compulsive engagement in rewarding stimuli despite harmful consequences. Physical dependence: body needs the substance to function normally (withdrawal symptoms without it). Psychological dependence: emotional/mental need (craving, inability to cope without it). | Key Fact: Biological explanation: the mesolimbic dopamine pathway (reward pathway). Addictive substances and behaviours cause dopamine release in the nucleus accumbens, producing pleasure. Repeated use reduces natural dopamine response, requiring more of the substance to achieve the same effect (tolerance).
